Can you provide those materials by end of day Friday (2026-06-19)? If you have a single zip or a shared folder, please include a README that maps each artifact to the RFP questions. Also let us know who to contact if we have clarification questions during review.

To be clear, reviewers will be internal and may ask for redlines on diagrams — we anticipate a short follow-up call the week of 2026-06-22.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this is a gating item for our security review.
